cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved carrying your book bag to the platform. My shoulder is delighted to be useful for one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I take it? There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please keep your hands free for the tickets. I authorize a change of shoulder at the bottom; no trouble at all.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved us to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The new route is approved. Lead on; I'll give each shoulder its own staircase. You may save my fingers a seat when you find ours.

reason: Let B considerate offer and route change receive gracious rulings that retain the task while making the growing physical inconvenience concrete.
